mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('ASSIGNED','ATTENDED')) AS live_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'ASSIGNED') AS expected_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'ATTENDED') AS attended_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'NO_SHOW') AS no_show_count, MIN(s.session_date) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'ASSIGNED') AS next_session_date, MAX(s.session_date) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'ATTENDED') AS last_attended_date FROM public.health_examination_session_assignments a JOIN public.health_examination_sessions s ON s.id = a.session_id WHERE a.participant_id = p.id ) asg ON true
CASE WHEN asg.attended_count > 0 THEN 'ATTENDED' WHEN asg.no_show_count > 0 AND asg.expected_count = 0 THEN 'NO_SHOW' ELSE 'UNCONFIRMED' END
